description: Northern Climate Reports - Projections of future conditions is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by University of Alaska Fairbanks; University of Alaska Fairbanks | International Arctic Research Center | Scenarios Network for Alaska + Arctic Planning; University of Alaska Fairbanks | International Arctic Research Center. For locations across Alaska and Western Canada, this site offers plain-language reports describing some of the environmental changes projected to occur as climate change alters Northern landscapes. Potential future conditions are based on results from climate and ecological models. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Economy, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
